To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the institutional arrangements that exist at any time in history are the result of the historical process of institutional change.

the institutional change in China's economic system is headed towards the reduction of the transaction costs in market transactions, and that the institutional changes are in a gradualistic and evolutionary process, which will ultimately lead to a fundamental change in the economic system.

the institutional change in China's agricultural market has been a gradualistic process in which the informal contractual arrangements have gradually been replaced by formal contractual arrangements, and in which the informal market has gradually been replaced by a formal market, thus gradually reducing the market transaction costs and promoting the growth of agricultural production."
In summary, our research is concerned with
the following questions.

the following two questions: first, what is the relationship between the evolution of the market and the evolution of the institutional arrangements, and what is the relationship among the three types of institutional change, that is, fundamental, secondary, and informal?

the following two aspects: first, the evolution of the market and its impact on informal contractual arrangements, and secondly, the impact of informal contractual arrangements on the evolution of the formal institutional arrangements.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
institutional change is the process by which the fundamental institutional arrangement is modified, amended, and circumvented.
the institutional arrangement that has the effect of reducing market transaction costs will be more easily adopted by people in the course of their economic activities.
institutional arrangements can be divided into two levels, the primary level, and the secondary level, and that there is a dynamic process of change between the two levels.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we have made a study on the institutional change in China's agricultural sector, and have made a systematic analysis of the changes in China's rural economy in the past 30 years, especially the changes in the contractual arrangements in rural areas.
we have made a great deal of progress in the study of market evolution and the evolution of informal contractual arrangements in the process of institutional change.

, the market evolution is the process in which the market gradually develops from a "primitive market" (the market with the lowest transaction cost) to a "highly developed market" (the highest transaction cost).
The main takeaway from our work is that
informal institutional arrangements can play a role in the process of market evolution.
the institutional arrangements in the market economy are not static, and that there are many different kinds of institutional changes.
, in the course of market evolution, the fundamental institutional arrangements are the most basic, and the most important.
